description: This is a test class for the MyReviewAPI component within the Performance API plugin of OrangeHRM. It contains test methods for the 'getAll' API endpoint and stub methods for other CRUD operations, which are not implemented. The class uses a data provider to generate multiple test cases and extends a base test class for endpoint testing.

classes.name: MyReviewsAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the MyReviewAPI, testing the 'getAll' endpoint with data-driven test cases and ensuring other API methods throw 'NotImplemented' exceptions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all reviews via the API using data provider cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'create' on the API throws a 'NotImplemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
